review_type: subjective visual inspection of exact sampled frames
scope: Twelve raw decoded frames at 2, 6, 10, and 14 seconds from three saved continuous four-CPU gameplay movies. Every listed frame was visually inspected. This is sampled-frame inspection, not viewing complete motion, human playtesting, or acceptance of the full build.
limitations: No claim of temporal animation smoothness, camera interpolation, hit timing, audio quality, or full-sequence visual correctness.
Sparse samples show movement, strike poses, overlaps, recovery, and one clear shield effect; they do not cover every attack, ultimate, launch, hazard warning, or particle burst.
All source movies and extracted frames are 1600x900 at 60 fps; this review is not 1080p performance evidence.
Human playtesting, physical-controller testing, weaker-PC performance, and final Windows package graphical validation remain unverified.
The GPU was unavailable during this review; extraction used software decoding only and no engine was launched.

extraction.output: Raw decoded PNG, no cropping, resizing, annotations, or retouching

The high P4 label is visible but has modest contrast against the dark tower.
